title: AI is the new storefront, and cost pressure will shape our PC pricing
summary: 55% of shoppers use AI in discovery (NIQ); 400M used Alexa for Shopping and spend 50% more (Amazon), which now opens Alexa to merchants. Samsung sees no memory relief before 2028; Apple plans 16M MacBook Neo units in 2027; HP named a new CEO.

points.headline: AI assistants steer discovery, and Amazon is opening Alexa to merchants
points.detail: 55% use AI in discovery (NIQ); Alexa shoppers spend 50% more; Amazon wins 59% of AI-assisted purchases and now lets merchants register. Our listings must work inside AI agents.

points.headline: Memory costs keep PC prices rising with no relief before 2028
points.detail: Samsung sees no buyer relief before 2028 and Asus expects commercial PC prices up nearly 10% in 2H26. Plan pricing, promotions and stock for sustained cost pressure.

points.headline: Apple and HP reshape the competitive PC field
points.detail: Apple told suppliers to plan 16M MacBook Neo units in 2027, double 2026, while HP named a new CEO amid memory costs. Expect entry-level promo pressure.
